name: Imperial Tombs of the Ming and Qing Dynasties
description: This World Heritage listing groups the burial grounds of China's last two imperial dynasties, with the Ming tombs and three 17th-century Qing tombs in Liaoning Province: Yongling, Fuling and Zhaoling. Built for the Qing founders and their ancestors, they were laid out by fengshui principles. Visitors find stone statues, carved reliefs and dragon-decorated tiles blending Chinese tradition with Manchu style.
